description:
Create a Master-Detail form in LibreOffice Base named 'ArtistDiscography'. 

1. Open the Chinook database.
2. Create a new form (using the Wizard or Design View).
3. The Main Form must display data from the 'Artist' table (include ArtistId and Name).
4. The Subform must display data from the 'Album' table (include Title) as a datasheet/grid.
5. Link the forms so that the Subform shows only albums belonging to the selected Artist (join on ArtistId).
6. Save the form as 'ArtistDiscography' and save the database file.
